knowledge_graph.description: Northeast Wisconsin Technical College is a public technical college with multiple locations in Wisconsin. The college serves nine Wisconsin counties with three campuses in Green Bay, Marinette, and Sturgeon Bay, and five regional learning centers in Shawano, Oconto Falls, Crivitz, Aurora, and Luxemburg.
knowledge_graph.merchant_description: "Two-year public college known for hands-on, high-tech learning – with degrees, classes, and training that help individuals soar higher. Enter off Country Club Road and come to our Welcome Center, on Level 2 of the Student Center. For assistance in Spanish, Hmong, Somali, or any other language, simply call or visit during our regular hours. We offer interpreter services in over 240 languages. Directions for deliveries: Take Packerland Ave. to Larsen Road; head west on Larsen to Receiving Road and head south; continue under skywalk into courtyard; look for receiving on the right."
